alt.en: A large gray camera stands at the center of a gray floor, its lens toward the front. A dashed teal line with an arrowhead runs from it to a standing card with lines of writing on the left, and a dotted gray line runs to a flat stack of pages with a teal header on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一台大号灰色相机，镜头朝前。一条带箭头的青绿色虚线从相机通向左侧一块写有几行字迹的立牌，一条灰色点线通向右侧一叠平放的、带青绿色页眉的纸页。

caption.en: Illustration: a camera stands for the advisory watch over the agent-framework releases, a standing card for the published notice and a stack of pages for the record of affected versions. It does not depict a tested deployment, the packages themselves or any real system.
caption.zh: 示意图：相机代表对 agent-framework 发布版本的安全公告监测，立牌代表已发布的公告，一叠纸页代表受影响版本的记录。本图并未描绘经过测试的部署，也不呈现软件包本身或任何真实系统。
